stemMd: Butane and 2-methylpropane have the same molecular formula but different carbon skeletons. They are examples of what?

options.label: E
options.textMd: Identical molecules with only different names

explanationMd: Structural isomers share a molecular formula but differ in how atoms are connected. A straight chain and a branched chain can therefore represent different compounds with the same composition.

distractorRationale.a: Both consist of carbon and hydrogen.
distractorRationale.b: Isotopes differ in neutron count of an element.
